title: BodyColorAbnormalityResistance
description: Per-color abnormality resistance rules, keyed by color id. Parsed into BodyColorAbnormalityResistanceRule (lib/domain/master_data/body_color_abnormality_resistance_rule.dart) — each key becomes colorId.

abnormalityResistanceBonuses.description: Maps an abnormality id (see abnormality_types.json) to the resistance bonus this color grants. Every body color's bonus is summed independently — a same-color pair adds it twice, and distinct colors are never halved or reduced.
